evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies outbound peer eviction and connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Ensures reliable transaction propagation by preventing full outbound slots from being consumed by non-relaying peers. As described in the problem statement, outbound slots occupied by peers declining transaction relay degrade broadcast topology and leave nodes with too few relaying outbound connections, addressing longstanding issues #16418 and #28371.
